info.name: Message API integration tests
info.description: End-to-end smoke tests replayed by newman in CI (MAIR-117). `baseUrl` is injected by docker-compose-integration.yml; the default in environment.json targets a local stack. JWTs are forged in the collection pre-request script with the stack's JWT_SECRET for the seeded Admin (user 1) and a plain user (user 2, seeded by init-test.sql; user 3 is also seeded). The scenario creates a chat, exchanges and edits messages from both users, manages participants, then deletes the chat, so it is replayable against a persistent database. The SSE stream is only checked unauthenticated.
